final: SELECT bats, COUNT(*) as tally, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_award) as share, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_award) - (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bats) FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id)) as excess FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bats HAVING share > (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bats) FROM player_award pa2 JOIN player p2 ON pa2.player_id = p2.player_id)) ORDER BY bats
